## What changed and why

<!-- Explain the change and the motivation. For docs, "why" is often more useful to a
future reader than "what". -->

## Type of change

- [ ] New documentation
- [ ] Update to existing documentation (content accuracy)
- [ ] Structural change (nav, templates, tooling)
- [ ] Fix (typo, broken link, formatting)

## Checklist

- [ ] Previewed locally with `mkdocs serve`
- [ ] Added new page(s) to `nav:` in `mkdocs.yml` (if applicable)
- [ ] Links checked (relative links to other docs pages)
- [ ] If this is a runbook or ADR, `docs/runbooks/index.md` or `docs/adr/index.md` was
      updated with a new row
